mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances despite the positive housing market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns over economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply contraction signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% MoM AND UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive economic signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening monetary policy signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 jobs in the last month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5%, it signals a weak economic environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of triggered instances despite the weak economic signal.
